dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, metadata, main instructions, and bundled references all align around auditing one content artifact against a CORE-EEAT framework with evidence gaps, scoring rules, and fix guidance.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Scope is limited to one declared URL, draft, or stable artifact plus related source controls; fetched page text and embedded prompts are explicitly treated as untrusted evidence.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown-only skill and reference files; duplicate files are byte-identical and scanners report no suspicious or malicious findings.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Declared WebFetch access and optional local scorer/validator use are proportionate to content auditing, and the standalone runtime is fail-closed when verified runtime files are unavailable.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs agents not to write memory by default; persistence requires explicit user authorization, a constrained memory/audits/content path, full-content Write, and validation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean report] expected: No issues were reported; direct artifact review is consistent with a markdown-only auditor workflow and did not reveal hidden authority expansion.
[VirusTotal clean telemetry] expected: All engines were undetected with no malicious or suspicious flags; this supports but does not determine the benign verdict.
[static scan clean] expected: The static scan reported no findings, and inspected artifacts showed no executable scripts, obfuscation, credential handling, destructive commands, or exfiltration behavior.
llm.guidance: Install if you want an agent to evaluate content quality and publish readiness. It may fetch URLs you provide and may read local framework/scoring files in a repository install, but saving audit artifacts is supposed to happen only after you explicitly approve it.
llm.summary: This skill is a bounded content-quality auditor that fetches or reviews user-provided content and only saves audit artifacts with explicit permission.
